newsitem.title: JAPAN: MOF says told DKB to check for more improper loans.
newsitem.headline: MOF says told DKB to check for more improper loans.

text.p: Finance Minister Hiroshi Mitsuzuka told a news conference on Wednesday that he had told Dai-Ichi Kangyo Bank Ltd (DKB) to check whether it made improper loans other than those related to the Nomura Securities Co Ltd racketeer scandal.
Mitsuzuka said he also asked DKB to make strenuous efforts to review its management in a bid to regain public trust lost because of the scandal.
"I have instructed the bank to check if it has had any (questionable) dealings other than loans related to the issue in question," he said.
DKB's executives revealed last Friday that the bank provided a cumulative total of 26 billion yen in loans to a company linked to an alleged racketeer.
